hready-soma conda environment setup
=====================================

py-soma-x requires chumpy, which conflicts with NumPy >= 2.0 in the main
hready env.  This env uses NumPy 1.x and runs only the SOMA-X worker script.

Create the env
--------------

    conda create -n hready-soma python=3.11 -y
    conda activate hready-soma
    pip install "numpy<2" scipy torch==2.11.0 py-soma-x==0.3.6

Verify install
--------------

    python -c "import soma; print(soma.__version__)"
    # expected: 0.3.6

Add to configs/paths.yaml
--------------------------

    soma_python: C:/Users/<you>/AppData/Local/anaconda3/envs/hready-soma/python.exe

Then run the item-17 check from the hready env:

    cd D:\projects\humanoid-ready
    conda activate hready
    python -c "
    import torch
    from hready.body.soma_x_wrapper import SomaXBridge
    bridge = SomaXBridge()
    B = 4
    poses  = torch.zeros(B, 55, 3)
    transl = torch.zeros(B, 3)
    rt = bridge.round_trip(poses, transl)
    print(f'SMPL-X -> MHR  per-vertex RMSE: {rt.smplx_to_mhr.per_vertex_rmse_m*1000:.2f} mm')
    print(f'MHR -> SMPL-X  per-vertex RMSE: {rt.mhr_to_smplx.per_vertex_rmse_m*1000:.2f} mm')
    print(f'Round-trip     per-vertex RMSE: {rt.round_trip_vertex_rmse_m*1000:.2f} mm')
    "

(Raw output must be shown; check files are not saved — AGENTS.md rule 5.)

Pinned versions
---------------

After creating the env, record the versions in env/versions.lock under the
[hready-soma] section:

    python -c "
    import soma, numpy, torch, scipy
    print('py-soma-x =', soma.__version__)
    print('numpy     =', numpy.__version__)
    print('torch     =', torch.__version__)
    print('scipy     =', scipy.__version__)
    "
